title: “Subverting the Jewtocracy”: Online Antisemitism Detection Using Multimodal Deep Learning
findings: The study developed a multimodal deep learning system to detect and categorize antisemitism. A specific category for 'Religious Antisemitism' was created, defined as bias against Jews for their belief in Judaism. The proposed multimodal model outperformed single-modal baselines, achieving accuracies of ~71% on Twitter and ~91% on Gab for binary classification. The multiclass categorization, which included the religious category, showed the model was often confused between 'Political' and 'Racial' antisemitism, as these categories frequently overlapped in the data.
